feedback: Pre-race review of the kd-only change: kd 0.4 to 0.6, with kp 3.0, base_speed 1.0, ki 0 and the iteration 0 sensor layout unchanged. Iteration 2 (kp 3.0, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.0) is still the best raced design at 169.5, so this candidate is judged against that bar. The candidate is valid: all sensor positions are inside the allowed ranges, the weights are unchanged at (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), and kd 0.6 is within [0, 10]. It changes one variable from the best design, so the next race isolates the effect of kd. The evidence that motivates it is iteration 2's s-bend max_error of about 0.063, which sits at the off-track limit, while rms_error stayed near 0.021, which points to bend overshoot rather than sensing. Iteration 1 showed that widening the array did not reduce max_error, so the candidate correctly does not repeat that change. The main risk is that iteration 2's oval steering_oscillation already rose to 0.34, so more kd may add jitter without reducing bend excursions. Racing is more informative than another revision here, and the candidate is a reasonable test. Do not state how it will perform. Once the race reports, use the results as follows. If s-bend max_error drops below 0.06 and oval progress holds at 0.6 or more, keep kd at 0.6 and then test base_speed in steps of 0.2 to recover progress. If steering_oscillation grows and progress falls, kd 0.6 is too high, so try kd 0.5. If max_error still reaches 0.06 on the s-bend with no gain, controller lag is not the whole story, so try ki of 0.05 to 0.1 with kd 0.6.
requested_changes: If s-bend max_error drops below 0.06 and oval progress holds at 0.6 or more, keep controller.kd at 0.6 and try controller.base_speed 1.2 to recover progress, since iteration 2 showed base_speed 1.0 with kp 3.0 kept line losses near 1.0.
If steering_oscillation rises (iteration 2 oval was already 0.34) and progress falls, reduce controller.kd to 0.5, because kd 0.6 is then too high.
If max_error still reaches about 0.06 on the s-bend with no gain from kd, set controller.ki to 0.05 to 0.1 with kd 0.6, since the iteration 2 bend error is not clearly explained by kd alone.
